Luminex (LMNX) Holder Rgm Capital Has Upped Holding; Harding Loevner LP Has Boosted Sasol LTD (SSL) Stake by $49.19 Million
June 29, 2018 - By Richard Conner
Robert G. Moses increased its stake in Luminex Corp (LMNX) by 10.2% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Rgm Capital Llc bought 293,498 shares as the company’s stock rose 34.60% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Robert G. Moses held 3.17M shares of the medical and dental instruments company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $66.84 million, up from 2.88M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Rgm Capital Llc who had been investing in Luminex Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $1.28 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.24% or $0.07 during the last trading session, reaching $28.88. About 122,195 shares traded. Luminex Corporation (NASDAQ:LMNX) has risen 33.74% since June 29, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 21.17% the S&P500. Harding Loevner Lp increased its stake in Sasol Ltd (SSL) by 56% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. The hedge fund held 4.03 million shares of the oil & gas production company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $137.38 million, up from 2.58M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Harding Loevner Lp who had been investing in Sasol Ltd for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $21.39B market cap company. The stock increased 2.59% or $0.89 during the last trading session, reaching $35.31. About 339,765 shares traded or 66.84% up from the average.
